description: Recent records from a common Calgary open dataset (data.calgary.ca) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Calgary 311 requests", "Calgary building permits". Names: 311, permits. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use calgary_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter, e.g. "incident_category='Larceny Theft'" or "supervisor_district=6". Omit for all recent rows.

name: calgary_recent
title: Calgary Recent
